success_criteria.empty_delta_projection: omit model-facing state and record deterministic suppression
success_criteria.novelty_gate: project each currently selected handle at most once per branch

records.falsifier: Any selected handle is unbound or repeated, any recycle lacks an auditable presentation/suppression decision, the full denominator is missing, scheduled span gain is below +0.05, file or valid completion degrades, unknown usage appears, or treatment cumulative model tokens exceed control.
records.mechanism: Select the H40 widest receipt-bound handle for each of the eight newest paths, then emit only selected handles never presented earlier in that branch. When the selected set contains no new handle, omit the state message and record the suppression.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Novelty-gating H40 widest-span state preserves its ContextBench quality gain while eliminating repeated handle delivery and bringing GLM-5.3-flash 8K cumulative model tokens to or below control.

stop_conditions: Never treat oracle output as deployable ARE behavior or benchmark clearance.

records.falsifier: Oracle does not exceed placebo and control on the fixed context metric, or the diagnostic leaks unobserved source.
records.mechanism: At each recycle, rank only already delivered source observations using sealed gold overlap for the oracle arm; compare with an equal-token non-gold placebo. Neither arm is deployable or eligible for benchmark clearance.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: The benchmark and model have a measurable state-recovery ceiling, and an oracle-selected receipt-bound state will outperform an equal-budget placebo.

records.falsifier: A frozen full-denominator development round and untouched confirmation both meet every fixed quality, validity, integrity, and token criterion.
records.mechanism: Observed gains arise from stochastic trajectory changes that cannot be retained under the fixed token gate.

selection.reason: H40 crossed every quality and validity gate, while 110/220 projected slots repeated prior handles and 24/86 presentations carried no new handle. H42 changes only that measured repetition mechanism. Failure routes to oracle/placebo calibration instead of another selector loop.
